root_cause.component: trusted Tailnet unsafe-request browser metadata guard
root_cause.failure: The authenticated switch request was rejected when the browser omitted at least one optional Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site metadata header even though the same browser session was valid. Credential-sensitive request capture was not used, so no stronger claim is made about which optional header was absent.
root_cause.effect: The router account panel received HTTP 403 before the switch bridge could reach the healthy account router.
root_cause.repair: Keep the exact session cookie and CSRF token mandatory, reject explicit non-matching Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site values, and accept an omitted optional metadata header for authenticated HTTP requests only. Site-key login and IPC WebSocket origin checks remain strict.

tests.command: bash -n R98 deploy; node --check R98 installer; default-contract installer fixture; git diff --check

r96_baseline.reason: R98 changed the deployed browser authentication server module, so a resumed clean-browser baseline must use R98 rather than R97.

residual_risks: Every accepted manual switch starts a new backend session; no previous request, conversation stream, in-flight work or computation is resumed.
The repair depends on the unguessable CSRF token plus the authenticated SameSite session when optional browser metadata is absent; explicit conflicting metadata remains rejected.
Optional Statsig telemetry still times out intermittently but did not block the verified composer or manual switch roundtrip.
R96 startup profiling remains pending and must use R98 as its production input.
